title: Augmented Datasheets for Speech Datasets and Ethical Decision-Making
findings: The paper recommends that speech dataset creators should document and consider avoiding content, such as texts from the Bible, that could impose specific religious values on data subjects. This is framed as a measure to prevent 'symbolic violence' and ensure the dataset content respects the diverse values of its users.
references: Enable the profanity filter; cloud speech-to-text documentation google cloud.
